feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence: iteration 0 (five 12 mm sensors at x ±0.02 m, y 0.05 m, mass 0.8, wheel_radius 0.03, wheel_track 0.12) scored 52.28, the best so far, with progress 0.138 (oval) and 0.148 (s-bend) and 1.0 to 2.0 line-loss events per run. Iteration 6 kept the same sensing and mass but set wheel_radius 0.035 and wheel_track 0.16. It scored 51.63, with oval progress 0.145 and s-bend progress 0.135. So the wheel change raised oval progress and lowered s-bend progress. Iterations 1 to 3 widened the sensing and lowered mass, and every one of them left line loss at 1.0 per run with lower progress. Steering oscillation has stayed between 0.07 and 0.14, so the robot is not jittering. Decision rules for the next race: (1) If s-bend progress returns to about 0.148 and line_loss_events stays at 1.0, the wheel change caused the s-bend loss, so keep wheel_radius 0.03 and wheel_track 0.12. Then test the sensor footprint on the same five positions. (2) If s-bend progress stays near 0.135 with wheel_radius 0.03 and wheel_track 0.12, the sensing is the cause, and the next test should be per-track telemetry on where the single loss occurs. (3) If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.2, the baseline is overshooting, so reduce kp before changing geometry.
requested_changes: Keep wheel_radius 0.03 m and wheel_track 0.12 m with the iteration 0 sensing (five 12 mm sensors at x -0.02 to +0.02 m, y 0.05 m) and mass 0.8 kg, if the s-bend progress recovers to about 0.148. Basis: iteration 0 gave the best s-bend progress, and iteration 6 lost about 0.013 of it with the larger radius and track.

If line_loss_events stays at 1.0 per run with the baseline sensing, test sensor_size 0.008 on the same five positions. Basis: no iteration has tested an 8 mm footprint, and a smaller footprint gives a sharper line-position signal. Test this only after the baseline result is confirmed.

If the oval progress gain from iteration 6 is needed, test wheel_radius 0.035 m with wheel_track 0.12 m, leaving the track at baseline. Basis: iteration 6 raised oval progress to 0.1446 with both wheel values changed, and it is unclear which one caused the gain or the s-bend loss.
